# Chain of Command
Authority in the Company follows paygrade. Your paygrade is printed on your identification card. Promotion is earned through tenure and results. The full grade structure is listed under [textlink="Grades and Callsigns" link="CMUCorporateHandbookGrades"/].
## Executive grades - [bold]WYC1 Trainee[/bold]: probationary office staff. - [bold]WYC2 Junior Executive[/bold]: office staff. - [bold]WYC3 Executive[/bold]: experienced office staff. May supervise trainees. - [bold]WYC4 Senior Executive[/bold]: senior office staff. Runs office tasks in the Liaison's absence. - [bold]WYC5 Executive Specialist[/bold]: Corporate Liaison. The Company's official representative at the site. - [bold]WYC6 Executive Supervisor[/bold]: senior Corporate Liaison. Trusted with decisions of consequence. - [bold]WYC7 Assistant Manager[/bold]: deputy to the Division Manager. - [bold]WYC8 Division Manager[/bold]: runs a site. Answers to the sector's Chief Executive. - [bold]WYC9 Chief Executive[/bold]: the sector chief. Oversees every site in the sector and answers only to the Directorate. - [bold]WYC10 Deputy Director[/bold] and [bold]WYC11 Director[/bold]: the Directorate, the Company's ruling board. Never posted to a site.
## Legal grades - [bold]WYC5L Legal Specialist[/bold] and [bold]WYC6L Legal Supervisor[/bold]: Company counsel. They advise on contracts, colonial law and exposure. Counsel don't command the executive grades, but an executive who ignores counsel answers for the consequences personally.
## Science The [bold]Lead Researcher[/bold] directs Company research at the site and answers to the senior executive present. Scientists answer to the Lead Researcher. Research is the Company's most valuable asset on any colony. Treat its staff, samples and records accordingly.
## Senior employee on site The highest-grade executive present is the senior employee on site. They decide disputes between departments and speak for the Company. - On most sites this is the [bold]Corporate Liaison[/bold] (WYC5 or WYC6). - Any employee of grade [bold]WYC7 or above[/bold] outranks the Liaison and takes over for as long as they're present.
## Restricted systems - The corporate console and the corporate Overwatch console are restricted to [bold]WYC5 and above[/bold]. - Divestment (see [textlink="Colonial Partnership" link="CMUCorporateHandbookPartnership"/]) can only be authorised at [bold]WYC5 and above[/bold]. - Work terminals are open to all Company staff.
